audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer sides disagreed with content win[] and the packet levelChart, and the page was rated TRICKY 7/10 against a 58.05% win rate over 2,744 games.
audit.why: Diana's Q is 900 range against Sigil of Malice at 700, and Pale Cascade covers the detonation, so levels 1-5 belong to Diana. Level 6 is LeBlanc's: Mimic doubles a chain-and-Sigil combo from outside Moonfall's 475-range pull. From first item Diana survives the front-loaded burst and out-lasts her.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides moved onto the content chart (Diana x4, LeBlanc at 6, Diana, Diana) with every why rewritten, whys[0], whys[1] and whys[3] corrected to match their rows, and the difficulty enums moved to FAVOURED 4.5/10 to match the win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes carried no numbers and treated level 6 as Diana's spike.
audit.why: Mimic is 45/35/25 and is the enemy spike here; Diana's own are Lunar Rush at 3 (22s) and first item.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten around the 45s Mimic and the item that answers it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two decisive interactions were absent: Ethereal Chains' 1.5-second delay and where Distortion returns her to.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them' — leaving its range inside that window means no root, and Lunar Rush is the exit. Distortion (600 range, 15/13.75/12.5/11.25/10) returns her to her starting location for 4 seconds, so that spot is where a Moonlight mark pays. Sigil of Malice is 6s flat at 700 range against Diana's 900.
audit.corrected: Both stated, with the ranges and cooldowns attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Distortion 15-10, Sigil 6 flat, Ethereal Chains 14-11, Mimic 45/35/25, Pale Cascade 15 at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Field rebuilt around those numbers. Note dosFull[2].d's 'fifteen-second invitation' was checked and is correct — Distortion is 15s at rank 1 — so it was left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mirror Image was never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Below 40% health LeBlanc turns invisible for 1 second and leaves a damageless clone for up to 8 seconds — that is what breaks a chase, and Moonfall's text says it 'reveals and draws in all nearby enemies'.
audit.corrected: Mirror Image named in the wave-chase don't and in breakdown.late as the case for Moonfall.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sixteen misgender findings plus two copy-paste bleeds (dosFull[1].d = tradeGood, dontsFull[2].d = tradeBad); phases[5].why claimed 'chunks half bars'; wants.foe[1] called Mimic 'R distortion'.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists leblanc as female; the bleeds sit under unrelated titles; the magnitude is unsourced; Mimic and Distortion are different spells.
audit.corrected: All fixed in the edits below.

edits.before: LeBlanc's poke and burst potential is scary but she's fragile and mana-limited, so avoid standing in sigil range and punish her when Q is down. Her all-in is real but low-value if it whiffs: she has no follow-up sustain. Farm behind Pale Cascade rather than trading blade for blade until you know her combo timing.

edits.before: At 6 her R-refresh combo can burst you down fast the first time it connects clean, so play around wards and don't get caught alone in the sidelane. Once she's spent her combo without a kill she has almost nothing left — that's your window to punish with Q-E. Look for all-ins the moment her distortion is on cooldown; she has no more burst to answer with.

Ethereal Chains only roots if you stay in its range for 1.5 seconds — Lunar Rush out of the chain and the root never lands. notes: Every full-layer side disagreed with content win[] and the packet, which agreed with each other, so I moved the full layer onto the content chart — no paired win[N] edits exist to propose because the content side was already correct. Final chart both layers: Diana, Diana, Diana, Diana, LeBlanc, Diana, Diana. I also moved diff/diffRating/tone off TRICKY 7/10: 58.05% over 2,744 games is a favoured lane and the enums are exempt from the length band. carryRating left at 7.5/10 — her level 6 kill threat is real. The Mirror Image / Moonfall reveal line is Medium confidence: Moonfall's Riot text says it 'reveals and draws in all nearby enemies', which I have stated as a reveal only — I have NOT claimed it distinguishes the clone or that the clone can be pulled.
